provenance.source_name: Kiran, Ayanian and Breuer, Influence of Static and Dynamic Downwash Interactions on Multi Quadrotor Systems
provenance.licence: not stated on the retrieved page
provenance.derived_by: Huda Mueen: 19 arm lengths (thrust within 95 to 98 percent of hover) multiplied by the arm length of the reference multirotor, taken as its radius_m of 0.24 m. The source measured Crazyflie vehicles (arm length 0.0325 m); transferring the result to a larger vehicle by arm length is an assumption.
provenance.notes: Preiss et al. (arXiv 1704.04852) use a vertical to horizontal ratio of 2.5 for Crazyflie vehicles; the sensitivity value 5.0 m applies that ratio to a 2.0 m horizontal radius.
